cases.name: Seychelle Schaumburg Jackson
cases.about:
(She) aspired to be a nurse and was one of the first in her family to attend college, both (her aunt Melissa) Winston and (her older sister Shawntee’) Howard said. But her main focus was always her kids. “My sister was so strong. Our whole life, we would call her grandma because she was so smart and beyond her years,” Howard said. “She saw the best in everyone. She was an amazing individual, so smart and so bright. She loved her babies with everything in her.” Howard said the last time she spoke with Jackson was a few days before her death. They talked about their kids, life’s challenges and how proud they were of each other’s accomplishments.

“We were just sharing sisterly love,” Howard said. “And I’m so glad that I had those last moments speaking with her.”
cases.narrative: He shot and killed her and her 5-year-old daughter and 14-year-old son. Her 9-year-old daughter was shot in the left hand but escaped to neighbors and survived the shooting, and had witness him shooting her mother in the face.
